article.title: MorningAI接入Mailchimp，圖像變體可先試三行再批次生成
article.title_en: MorningAI connects Mailchimp and adds table-based image variations
article.summary: MorningAI於11月23日加入Mailchimp連接器，並讓Studio按表格批次製作既有圖像的變體。
article.summary_en: MorningAI added a Mailchimp connector and a table workflow for making variations of an existing Studio image.
highlights: Mailchimp修改前會顯示批准卡，涵蓋聯絡人、活動及發送排程。
圖像變體單次最多100行，可先生成前三行作檢查。
highlights_en: An approval card precedes Mailchimp changes, including contact, campaign and sending operations.
Image runs support up to 100 rows, with an option to try the first three.
article.why: 電郵營運與素材版本管理可接在同一工作流程，團隊可先用少量變體確認規格，再決定是否擴大整批製作。
article.why_en: Email and creative operations can test a small set of variants before committing a complete campaign batch.
article.next_step: 把一份活動的城市、標題及產品圖片列成表格，先試三行；通過品牌核對後，再生成其餘版本並寄出測試電郵。
article.next_step_en: Tabulate cities, headlines and product images for one campaign, try three rows, then review before generating the rest and sending a test email.
article.detail: 品牌管理員需先在DNA的連接器設定接入Mailchimp，同品牌成員才可在Agent選用。系統支援草擬或修改活動、執行寄送前檢查及安排發送；郵件成效亦會顯示在Performance。Studio可匯入CSV或為各行加入照片，讓每個版本的修改要求清楚對應。批准卡是操作控制，不能代替逐項檢查收件對象與素材。
article.detail_en: A brand admin connects Mailchimp under DNA before members use it in the Agent. The connector supports campaign drafts, pre-send checks and scheduling, with email results in Performance. Studio accepts CSV tables and row-specific photos. Treat approval cards as an operational control and review recipients and assets separately.
